claims.hypothesis: Does the cold ISM of a typical, IR-faint z~2 galaxy resemble that of local star-forming galaxies?
claims.experiment: ALMA band 9 [CII] observation of lensed arc, compared with literature [CII]/FIR and [CII]/CO
claims.result: L_CII/L_FIR ≈ (1.2-2.4)e-3 and L_CII/L_CO = 2.3e3, similar to nearby galaxies
claims.finding: Cold ISM of typical high-z galaxies resembles normal local star-forming galaxies; larger samples needed

evidence.quote: our results provide evidence that the cold ISM of typical high redshift galaxies has physical characteristics similar to normal star forming galaxies in the local Universe.

why_this_data.value: Lensing allows probing typical lower-luminosity galaxies

evidence.quote: Gravitationally lensed sources offer a unique chance to sample this regime.

limitations_admitted.value: Delivered data did not meet requested sensitivity; ~25% flux calibration uncertainty

evidence.quote: Although the delivered data did not meet our requested sensitivity, it is sufficient to examine the average ISM/PDR properties
